grouping.cross_source_policy: Lock external v2 first; exclude entire main components touching any of its 4,100 inputs by normalized exact or candidate Jaccard >=0.5
grouping.document_closure_scope: Full English reserve plus historical source/preparation candidates and complete documents of all metadata/task components touching prior selected pairs or historical tasks
grouping.exact_near_algorithm: Collision-free packed word trigrams; exact shared-order prefix join
grouping.limitation: Lexical/document/task closure reduces dependence; semantic template identity and model training overlap are not certified.
grouping.task_closure_scope: Entire labeled training metadata plus historical source/preparation tasks

partition_rule: One frozen hash representative per final component; hash order first200development then3000confirmation
